newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London drift in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London drift in quiet session.

text.p: Japanese shares were trading modestly higher in London on Tuesday with activity thin and interest patchy, dealers said.
In early afternoon the Nikkei 50 was steady around the 1,432.99 level, a gain of just 2.45 points on the day.
"We've seen a bit of selling in large cap stocks across the board but there is a little buying interest as well," said one London dealer.
But overall business was scarce. West Japan Railway, which made its debut in Tokyo overnight, failed to attract much interest in a lacklustre session.
Wall Street provided little direction at the start of trading, with stocks opening narrowly mixed and T-bonds steady.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 ended 122.48 points lower at 21,038.53 in sluggish trading in the lead up to the general election on October 20.
